# Ghareeb Fencing Solutions

> Fence installer in Toledo, Ohio. Family owned. Serves Northwest Ohio and Southeast Michigan.

## Contact
- Phone: (419) 214-2107
- Email: nick@ghareebfence.com
- Office: 5242 Tractor Rd Suite C, Toledo, OH 43612
- Hours: Monday to Saturday, 8 am to 6 pm. Closed Sunday.
- Website: https://ghareebfence.com/

## What we install
- Cedar and pressure-treated wood: dog-ear privacy, board-on-board, shadowbox, lattice top, cap and trim, horizontal, spaced picket, ranch rail
- Vinyl: privacy, semi-privacy, picket and ranch rail, in several colors
- Ornamental aluminum
- Chain link, galvanized and black, up to 6 ft
- Split rail
- [Pool fences](https://ghareebfence.com/fences/pool-fencing/)
- Gates to match, and removal of an old fence

## Good to know
- Free on-site measure and written proposal
- 3-year workmanship warranty
- Licensed and insured
- Financing through Slice by FNBO. No interest if paid in full within 18 months. Interest builds from the start. If a balance is left after 18 months, the interest is owed and the rate is 18.99% fixed from then on. Monthly payments are required. For qualified customers, subject to credit approval.
- Installs through the winter. A signed job with a deposit holds its quoted price through a spring install.
- Service area: Toledo and Northwest Ohio (Sylvania, Perrysburg, Maumee, Oregon, Rossford, Northwood, Bowling Green), Monroe County, Michigan (Monroe, Temperance, Lambertville, Dundee) and Downriver Michigan. Each town has its own page with its permit office: https://ghareebfence.com/service-areas/

## How we set posts
- Clay soil: 8 ft galvanized steel posts driven 4 ft into the ground, 8 ft apart. On wood fences the steel is boxed in wood.
- Sandy soil: posts set in concrete.
- Wood gates get welded steel frames.
- Wood fences follow the slope of the yard instead of stepping.
